baseline.note: measured on the clone at the dispatched SHA before any edit, so every red below this line is mine

seamAsRead.gatingIsMandatory: src/fixture-seam.mjs:268-279 assertDomainShape requires a non-empty gatedBy AND adapterKindById(gatedBy) to resolve; src/fixture-seam.mjs:372 composeDomain generates only when pack.fixtureGrants includes domain.gatedBy. There is no ungated generation path.
seamAsRead.guardsRunAtTheSeam: src/fixture-seam.mjs composeDomain runs assertRecordShape, assertNoRealWorldContent and assertDeclaredVocabulary over every returned record, and assertNoRealWorldContent over extras. A generator calls no guard. Extras deliberately skip the vocabulary guard because counting rules are prose.
seamAsRead.formatsReplaceRatherThanExtend: defineDomain is { formats: DEFAULT_FORMATS, ...spec } — a domain that declares formats REPLACES the default pair, so any domain using place must re-declare PLACE_LABEL_FORMAT itself.
seamAsRead.fourStates: ok, granted-empty, ungranted, no-fixture-source (DOMAIN_STATUSES). not-registered is the fifth and lives in composeDomainById, and is the only surviving meaning of "not built".
seamAsRead.catalogAlreadyCorrected: The build sheet says the adapter catalog is short by three (spireon, goto, powerbi). At source it is NOT: G-91 already added all three, src/adapters.mjs ADAPTER_KINDS.length === 10, asserted in src/adapters.test.mjs. This lane adds ZERO adapter kinds. Reporting a planner figure as wrong: the build sheet section "Adapter catalog is short by three" is stale as of c7d7980.

domainsToBuild.moneyRule: a CIP register is the one domain on this lane that naturally carries money, and it carries NONE. The absence is written positively in budgetBasis and declared in RECORD_SHAPES.powerbi as a required:false budget field with a basis. The seam's money guard would reject a figure anyway; stating it in the contract means a later lane sees why.

domainsToBuild.statusSet: none. A volume bucket has no in-flight status; RECORD_SHAPES.goto declares statusValuesBasis saying so rather than leaving the field blank.
domainsToBuild.subtractionRule: callsAnswered and callsAbandoned are each drawn from the PRNG and callsOffered is their SUM. No reported class is derived by subtracting another (DEV_PROCESS 1.3); a reconciliation test asserts byQueue, byDay and totals all count the same record array.
domainsToBuild.privacyExclusion: goto call-history individual call detail, call recordings and extension-to-person mapping are NOT generated, and are declared in RECORD_SHAPES.goto as required:false fields carrying a basis

vendorlessQuestion.subject: Parks facilities and Court docket, which the build sheet records as "gates: none yet — sources arrive per city"
vendorlessQuestion.finding: PROVISIONAL AT CP1, to be re-proven at CP2 against the branch: a vendorless domain is NOT expressible in the seam as it stands.
vendorlessQuestion.evidenceRun: probe executed against the clone at c7d7980
evidence: src/fixture-seam.mjs:270-273 — defineDomain({...}) with gatedBy omitted, "" or null throws `a domain requires gatedBy`
src/fixture-seam.mjs:275-277 — gatedBy "none" throws `domain parks-facilities is gated by none, which is not a catalogued adapter kind`; gatedBy "parks" throws the same
src/city-pack.mjs:317-320 — fixtureGrants: ["parks"] throws `fixtureGrants names parks, which is not a catalogued adapter kind`, so even a pack cannot name a non-vendor source

src/adapters.mjs:341-342 — assertRecordShape throws `no record shape declared for kind X` unless RECORD_SHAPES is keyed by a catalogued kind, and every generated record carries that vendor id in its `kind` field
src/fixture-seam.mjs:372-380 — the only non-generating outcome for a built region is `ungranted`, whose basis sentence is literally `<VendorDisplayName> is not granted on <cityKey>`
vendorlessQuestion.consequenceIfForced: Registering Parks or Court would require inventing an adapter kind with no live vendor behind it, which this dispatch forbids and which would print a fictitious vendor name into every generated record's `kind` field and into the customer-visible ungranted basis line.
vendorlessQuestion.plannedDisposition: Do not register parks-facilities or court-docket. Land the finding as a machine-checkable test rather than prose, so a later lane cannot re-derive it by archaeology, and route the design question to the operator.
vendorlessQuestion.sideEffectToPreserve: src/domains.test.mjs already uses composeDomainById(TEMPLATE_CITY, "parks-facilities") as its not-registered exemplar. Registering that id would have silently deleted that assertion's subject. Leaving it unregistered keeps it.

packChange.whyThisIsNotAFeedGrant: fixtureGrants is the DEMONSTRATION axis, declared at src/fixture-seam.mjs:300-315 and src/city-pack.mjs:30-44; it carries adapter kind ids only, never a sourceUrl, and assertCityPackShape refuses any grantedAdapters entry on a generating pack. No network, no vendor, no city rows are read by this lane. spireon is deliberately still absent so the ungranted exemplar stays reachable.

adversarialReview.risk: Adding fixtureGrants reads as connecting a feed, violating the dispatch's `no adapter is granted`.
adversarialReview.disposition: Held. The two axes are structurally separate and assertCityPackShape enforces it. grantedAdapters stays [] on all three packs and the existing assertion in src/domains.test.mjs proving that is left untouched.

adversarialReview.risk: A camera inventory region reads as filling Assets, breaking the standing `G-24 stays zero`.
adversarialReview.disposition: Mitigated. recordType is camera-device, lensId is police, and every record carries an inventoryBasis saying vendor camera telemetry is not a city-owned inventory node — the same shape src/domains/fleet-vehicles.mjs uses for trucks. The registry-wide assertion that no domain has lensId assets or region Assets stays green.

adversarialReview.risk: Reusing VEHICLE_STATUS_VALUES for fire apparatus overloads a set named for vehicles.
adversarialReview.disposition: Accepted deliberately. Apparatus readiness is the same four bands; a second identical set for one subject is two implementations of one rule (DEV_PROCESS 2.4). Stated at the domain so a reader is not left guessing.

adversarialReview.risk: Four new domains land in src/domains.mjs which the Development services lane also edits, and in four shared test files.
adversarialReview.disposition: Accepted, and minimised. New assertions go in a NEW file src/department-domains.test.mjs which no sibling touches; only the unavoidable literals in the four existing test files are edited, and registry additions are appended contiguously after PATROL_VEHICLES_DOMAIN. Rebase expected; DS merges first.

adversarialReview.risk: The privacy exclusion is prose and a later lane adds LPR because nothing stopped it.
adversarialReview.disposition: Mitigated. The exclusion is written into RECORD_SHAPES as required:false fields with a basis, and asserted by a test that scans every generated record of the two domains for the excluded classes. A control that depends on someone remembering is not a control (DEV_PROCESS 0).
